issue_description: Profile records are migrating from the legacy `name` field to `display_name`. Reads must accept either spelling, prefer `display_name` when both are present, and continue enforcing the existing required-value checks. Writes must emit only the canonical `display_name` field so a read/write round trip does not recreate legacy data. Preserve optional active=false values and do not mutate input payloads.
success_condition: Visible tests and independent external acceptance tests pass.
